latestCommit.description:
Request a shared-site refresh after the registered main report workflow
succeeds, so published progress does not wait for the site's periodic
poll.

The separate `workflow_run` notifier pins the site's reusable workflow
at `5e3f6b64a9d1936752c03a7009e6ced81199b3a9`. It accepts successful
same-repository main push/manual completions only, never checks out
producer code, and uses the site-only App to send an authenticated run
hint. The site's normal importer still validates every report and
approved workflow policy. The build/report workflow itself is unchanged,
so its approved blob stays valid.

Configured setup: `PORTFOLIO_APP_CLIENT_ID` repository variable and
`PORTFOLIO_APP_PRIVATE_KEY` Actions secret. The App is installed only on
`mitsevox/mitsevox.github.io`; policy approval and merges stay manual.
The App installation is verified site-only; credentials are installed
and site deployment at the pinned revision succeeded.

Validation: actionlint passed. The shared site tests cover rejected
forks, PRs, failures and wrong workflows; receiver reauthentication;
unchanged-run skips; per-source failure isolation; and publication
recovery. No game source or measurements changed; no local target-binary
result is claimed. Hosted producer PR CI passed. An actual main
completion → dispatch → site update remains rollout evidence.

Independent hostile infrastructure review (`notifier_hostile`): SHIP on
the exact committed caller. No blocking findings in event/fork/path
gating, environment inputs, validated dispatch payload or site-only
token scope. No merge authority is implied.
